# Rebuilding the toolshed door and frame

The toolshed door frame has sagged enough that the door no longer latches
without a shove. One option on the table is a full frame rebuild over a
weekend, using pressure-treated lumber and new hinges, rather than another
temporary shim. It would cost a Saturday and a modest supply run, and it
would settle a problem that keeps coming back every few months.
